paragraphs: Chinena, son of Rav Assi, was a physician and threw a bill of divorce to his wife: Jerusalem Gittin, chapter 1. There, chapter 3, halakhah 8: Chinena son of Rav Assi bar Mammal, in R. Lazar's name. At the end of chapter 1 of Maaserot: Chananyah bar Yasa.
